conditions: One or more products have been added to the cart
User navigates to the cart page
items.expected: The cart page loads and displays each added product; each row shows the product's quantity, name and price

conditions: At least one product is in the cart
User clicks the remove button for that product
items.expected: The remove button is activated; the product row disappears from the cart list and the cart badge count decreases by one

conditions: At least one product is in the cart
User clicks Continue Shopping from the cart
items.expected: The product list page is shown; the cart badge still reflects the number of items that were in the cart before continuing

conditions: At least one product is in the cart
axe-core scans the cart page with WCAG A and AA rules
items.expected: No accessibility violations are reported (violations array is empty)

excluded.reason: Bug #121 (problem user pictures) affects the product list page, not the cart review behaviour of this story. Bug #122 (error user cannot finish an order) affects checkout completion (story #117), not the cart review. Neither Active bug touches story #114's ACs, so no confirmation test is warranted here.

Story #114 is about reviewing cart contents after sign-in. It introduces no authentication, session or data-protection behaviour beyond what the login story already covers; there is nothing cart-specific to assert about account protection through the browser.
Active bug about problem user seeing the same picture for every product — affects the product list page, not the cart review page that is this story's subject.
Active bug about error user unable to finish an order — affects the checkout completion flow (story #117), not the cart review behaviour covered by story #114.
